fields.Name: IT20 - Lists Keyset Pagination
fields.Description: Live proof of the v5.48 ListSource keyset-pagination change (StartRow/OFFSET → AfterKey seek over ListDetail.ID), deterministic (no model calls). LS1: full iteration returns every member exactly once in ID-seek pages. LS2: resume from a persisted keyset cursor on a fresh instance continues without overlap or gaps. LS3: a legacy Offset cursor is honored for its resume batch and converts to keyset. The bundle creates + tears down its own throwaway MJ: Lists row + members.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Keyset iteration is exhaustive and unique; a persisted cursor resumes cleanly; a legacy Offset cursor converts to keyset.
